thesis: This episode argues that investors should focus on exceptional, well-diversified businesses like Amazon, Costco, and Berkshire Hathaway, while avoiding poor companies like ASOS. It also highlights the value of studying specific investment examples, such as Raysas and a Turkish Coke bottler, to understand currency dynamics and management quality.
